title: Toponymic Data from Implementation of Participatory Toponym Handling (PTH) in Yogyakarta

contacts.affiliation: Faculty of Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation

descriptions: This dataset contains spatial and attribute data resulting from three collaborative toponym data collection projects carried out in 2018 in the Special Region of Yogyakarta, Indonesia. These projects represent multi-stakeholder efforts to preserve local geographical names (toponyms) and improve spatial data quality through participatory methods.
